 Discover Gulf Shores' 
 BEST BURGER 
 Bleus Burger in Gulf Shores, AL, elevates the humble burger to an art form. We specialize in gourmet craft smash burgers, alongside crispy wings, juicy tenders, and inventive sandwiches. Not just a burger joint, we offer vibrant veggie options and fresh salads. Pair your meal with a handcrafted cocktail or explore our selection of fifteen craft beers on tap. It's flavor, elevated.

 Half-Pound Craft Smash Burgers 
 With House-made Sauces and Toppings and only the freshest CAB premium ground beef. 
 
 
 Button 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Sides 
 More than fries. We've got sides galore! 
 
 
 Button 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Comfort Food 
 House Made Pasatas, Soups, and Cajun Dishes 
 
 
 Button 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Craft Beer & Cocktails 
 Fifteen taps to choose from 
 
 
 Button 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 meatArtboard 5 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 We use 100% FRESH CAB chuck, sourced from Alabama-based, family owned Evans Meats. Supporting small farms and ranches in Alabama. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Our toppings are as fresh as it gets. All burger sauces are made in house with love. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Not a fry-guy (or gal)? We've got you covered. O-rings, house-made tots, chips & queso, fried okra, Mac & Cheese, hand-cut slaw, sweet potato fries and more.! 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Fifteen taps of craft beer with a great bourbon selection and craft cocktails. 
 
 
 
 
 
 Bleus Burger is a 
 From Scratch Kitchen 
 We use only the freshest and finest ingredients possible. All of our burger and fry sauces are made from scratch daily right in our kitchen in Gulf Shores. Our burgers are 100% fresh, NEVER frozen, premium CAB beef, hand-smashed to order. You'll never get "superstore" meat at Bleus. Ask before you eat!

 BEST BURGER 
 Bleus Burger in Gulf Shores, AL, elevates the humble burger to an art form. We specialize in gourmet craft smash burgers, alongside crispy wings, juicy tenders, and inventive sandwiches. Not just a burger joint, we offer vibrant veggie options and fresh salads. Pair your meal with a handcrafted cocktail or explore our selection of fifteen craft beers on tap. It's flavor, elevated.

 From Scratch Kitchen 
 We use only the freshest and finest ingredients possible. All of our burger and fry sauces are made from scratch daily right in our kitchen in Gulf Shores.
